description: Change DB parameters (PATCH /mysql/v1/clusters/{clusterName}/config, merge-patch → 202 Operation). applyWithoutRestart defaults to TRUE here (the API default is false = DB restart); with true, non-dynamic parameters are rejected with 400 — set applyWithoutRestart=false to accept a restart. Use dryRun=true to preview.

applyWithoutRestart.description: true (tool default) = only dynamic parameters, no restart; false = allow non-dynamic parameters, the DB restarts

clusterName.description: Cluster name (3-30 chars, lowercase letters/digits/'-', no leading or trailing '-'; immutable after creation)

name: ncloud_serverless_update_config
